what_happened: Layout 9. 232-336 the gripper descended to the drawer handle, which sat above-left of the finger gap in the wrist view; at 336-352 the fingers closed on air (width 0.0087 at 352, no drawer contact at all). The fingers stayed closed until ~1120. The robot then drove to the dining counter (560-1000) with the empty closed gripper and hovered near the cup, as if delivering the straw; it reopened the gripper after ~1120 but did nothing useful. Drawer 0 and straw untouched (min eef 0.33 m).
causal_chain: handle off-centre in the finger gap -> closed on air at 336 -> carried on to the dining counter empty-handed (560-1000) -> drawer never opened, straw never picked -> timeout
self_recovery: none: no second attempt at the handle.
official_criterion_notes: The packet registers no drawer touch; the missed handle grasp is only visible as an on_nothing close at 336.
